messages:
Maria (CS): Heads up — Halcyon Analytics asking to switch to Net60 and shorten to a 9‑month renewal instead of annual. They want to pay via PO (no CC). PO reference is HAL-2026-09 but vendor code in the PO doesn't match our billing entity. This is a revenue recognition / activation risk. cc @Ben (AE) @Priya (Finance)

Ben (AE): Customer's CFO prefers Net60 to align with their AP cycle. They're pushing procurement to issue PO today. They do not want upfront CC. Can we accept Net60 for the first term if they sign a 9mo commitment?

Priya (Finance): Finance note: Net60 can be allowed with (1) vendor code match, (2) signed PO that references our SOW, and (3) credit check or pre-approval. Also need explicit invoice schedule in billing system. Tagging @Jonah for legal review on deferral language.

Jonah (Legal): Legal: Net60 itself isn't a blocker. We need the PO to reference the correct Redwood legal entity and include the agreed payment clause. We'll also add an addendum clarifying termination rights and late-payment interest. If PO is unsigned (procurement email only) that's riskier.

Sam (SE): For onboarding: if payment is expected >30 days after start, recommend we delay Dedicated capacity provisioning or enable reduced-capacity flag. We can run in a throttled mode for 30 days to protect capacity while they clear payment.

Lily (Payments): Payments Ops: we can accept a PO and set Net60 terms, but vendor code mismatch will bounce the PO back to customer and delay invoicing. If AE can get the correct vendor code today, we can create a draft invoice with Net60 due date.

Maria (CS): @Ben can you confirm vendor code & whether PO will include a signature? Also need procurement contact for routing.

Ben (AE): Pinged AP team just now, asked for vendor code and signed PO. They said they'll push signed PO with vendor_code=HALCY-UK by EOD (they confirmed over email). CFO added interest-on-late clause but will accept addendum.

payments-bot: Invoice draft created: HAL-2026-09 (draft) — status: pending vendor-code confirmation. Link: https://pay.redwood.example/invoices/draft/HAL-2026-09

Priya (Finance): I'll place a credit-hold flag until the signed PO with matching vendor code is in our system. Once PO is attached, Finance will release hold and schedule invoice. @Maria please confirm onboarding plan.

Maria (CS): Noted. I'm putting onboarding on hold and notifying the PM team: "Activation delayed until Finance clears or we enable trial throttle."

Jonah (Legal): When PO is uploaded, please ping me. I'll attach the addendum with late payment interest and termination protections. This should keep legal exposure low.

Lily (Payments): Once PO and vendor code are in, I'll post invoice and set Net60 terms in billing. Will also set reminders for day 45 and day 55 to the customer's AP.

Ben (AE): Customer confirmed signed PO will arrive by EOD and vendor code matches HALCY-UK. Sending the email thread to payments@redwood.

Maria (CS): Great — thanks everyone. I'll update the renewal tracker (row: Halcyon Analytics) and mark as "pending invoice". Will reopen onboarding once Finance clears. :white_check_mark:

Lily (Payments): Marking thread for follow-up. Will close once invoice posted and PO attached.

Maria (CS): Closing notes: next steps summary sent to the customer: 1) We need signed PO with vendor code HALCY-UK, 2) Redwood will accept Net60 for this order, 3) Onboarding remains on hold until Finance releases. Will update if anything changes.
